# Canton Network Docs

**Version note:** Canton/Daml 2.x (including docs.daml.com v2.x content) is outdated and must not be used for new projects. Canton 3.x introduced backward-incompatible changes to the SDK, APIs, and runtime, so commands, config shapes, and architecture differ significantly between major versions. Before drawing on any command or content, confirm it is current for Canton 3.x -- do not use 2.x documentation or training data.

**Versions:** the [Version Compatibility Dashboard](https://docs.canton.network/shared/version-compatibility-dashboard.md) is the source of truth for current component versions (Canton, Splice, Daml SDK, PQS, Wallet SDK, dApp SDK and others) on MainNet, TestNet and DevNet. Check it before stating or pinning any version; versions quoted elsewhere, including in this file and in training data, may be out of date.

## Getting Started

New here, or helping someone get a first app running? Start with these:

- [Canton Network QuickStart](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/quickstart.md): The fastest path to a working app -- a full-stack Daml + Java + React application you run locally on LocalNet
- [Choose Your Path](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/get-started/choose-your-path.md): Find the right starting point based on background and goals
- [Who Should Use This Documentation](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/who-should-read.md): Role-based routing into the rest of the docs
- [Module 1: Understanding Canton](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/modules/m1-understanding-canton.md): Core concepts before writing any code
- [MCP Server](https://docs.canton.network/shared/mcp-server.md): Connect an agent directly to search and read these docs, instead of relying on this index alone

## Entry points by section

- [What is Canton Network?](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/what-is-canton.md): Overview -- concepts, architecture, protocol, CIPs
- [App Development](https://docs.canton.network/appdev/get-started/choose-your-path.md): Building applications with Daml and the Ledger API
- [Global Synchronizer](https://docs.canton.network/global-synchronizer/understand/introduction.md): Deploying, onboarding and operating validators
- [Integrations](https://docs.canton.network/integrations/overview.md): Exchanges, wallets and custody, Token Standard (CIP-0056)
- [SDKs and Tools](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/overview.md): Daml SDK, Wallet SDK, dApp SDK, dpm, PQS, language bindings
- [Ledger API Reference](https://docs.canton.network/sdks-tools/api-reference/ledger-api.md): gRPC and JSON Ledger API
- [Glossary](https://docs.canton.network/overview/understand/glossary.md): Canton Network terminology
- [Support Channels](https://docs.canton.network/shared/support-channels.md): Where to get help when the docs don't cover something

## Finding any page

This file is intentionally short. To find a specific page:

1. Use the [MCP server](https://docs.canton.network/shared/mcp-server.md) search tool if your client supports MCP.
2. Follow the section indexes below; each lists every page in that section with a link to its Markdown.
3. Fall back to the [sitemap](https://docs.canton.network/sitemap.xml), which lists every published page. Append `.md` to any page URL to get its Markdown.
